speaker: Megan Palmer
words: Today I'm here speaking with Christina Tramack on December 4th, 2025 for the Everyday Harmony Oral History Project. speaker: Christina Tramack
words: Thanks for coming up and being here.

speaker: Megan
words: Thank you. So, for most people I might ask a question, like, "How did you first get involved in barbershop?" But that seems like kind of a silly question for you. speaker: Christina
words: Yeah, so barbershop has always been around in my life. I was born into it quite literally. My parents met through barbershop. speaker: Megan
words: You're like the third generation on one side?

speaker: Christina
words: Yeah, I'm third on my mom's. My mom's mom started in Harmony Inc. the year they began in 1959. So she would — she would claim she was not a charter member, but she was.
